_comment: Retrieval tests for the practice pattern library (kb/practice/). Each question must return the expected card doc_id in the top 3. Run after syncing kb/practice/. Note: scripts/test_retrieval.py currently hardcodes retrieval_tests.json, so it needs a file-path option (or a merge of the two test files) to run these. If a test fails, fix the card (or the question if it was unfair), never lower the bar.
